image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a grey whale surfacing in teal ocean water. The whale's head and upper back are visible, showing characteristic mottled grey skin with white barnacle patches. A portion of a blue and yellow boat is visible in the bottom left corner.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is relatively short with arched rostrum and two blowholes on top.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The angle is from the side/top, but the blowholes are not clearly visible or distinguishable from the skin texture in this specific crop/angle.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Skin is mottled grey to greyish-black with distinctive white patches from barnacles and whale lice.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The skin clearly exhibits the characteristic mottled grey pattern with distinct white callosities/barnacle patches.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: No dorsal fin present; multiple dorsal knuckles along posterior back.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible portion of the back shows no dorsal fin, consistent with grey whale anatomy. Dorsal knuckles are implied by the ridge shape though not fully resolved.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Robust spindle-shaped body of enormous proportions.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible mass suggests a large, robust body typical of a baleen whale.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Skin is mottled grey with white patches created by barnacles.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Consistent with the head checkpoint; the texture is accurate.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Baleen plates are cream-colored, densely packed in numerous rows along each side.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The mouth is closed and underwater; baleen plates are not visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Flippers (pectoral fins) are broad and paddle-shaped, remarkably elongated relative to body size.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Pectoral fins are submerged and not visible in this frame.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail flukes are broad with smooth trailing edge and central notch.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail is out of frame.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Skin texture is rough with callosities.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The surface texture appears rough and uneven, consistent with real whale skin and barnacle encrustation.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'wetness' of the skin. AI often fails to render the specific specular highlights of wet, rough skin correctly. Also, verify that the white patches look like attached organisms (barnacles) rather than just painted-on noise.
